headline: The real Android app reaches its honest account handoff
overview: A fresh emulator walk through the actual Leela Quest APK from language selection and native onboarding to the Android authentication surface.

steps.title: Android starts with language
steps.action: Cleared the package and launched the installed APK.
steps.description: The native Android app begins with the same explicit language decision as iPhone.

steps.title: Ancient wisdom is introduced natively
steps.description: The Android onboarding explains the origin and self-discovery purpose of Leela.
steps.screenshotAlt: Leela Quest Ancient Wisdom onboarding on Android

steps.title: Divine play sets the interaction model
steps.action: Advanced to the second onboarding screen.
steps.description: Chance is framed as an opening for reflection rather than a prediction.
steps.screenshotAlt: Leela Quest Divine Play onboarding on Android

steps.title: The final card asks for a real intention
steps.description: The native flow connects the game to a question the player genuinely wants to examine.
steps.screenshotAlt: Leela Quest final onboarding card on Android

steps.title: Android stops at the real account boundary
steps.action: Tapped Begin Your Quest and stopped before authentication.
steps.description: The fresh Android package asks for Google or email sign-in to save progress and unlock all features. No account was selected or created.
steps.screenshotAlt: Leela Quest native Android sign-in screen

note: Captured from the actual com.humanquest.leela APK, version 1.2.18+72, on the Small_Phone_API_35 emulator. The APK was prebuilt, so no exact source SHA is claimed.
